formulaBlock.normalization: Aqua/Water, Mel/Honey, Mel Extract/Honey Extract, Parfum/Fragrance each one entry; normalized one-based positions.
formulaBlock.e3ProminenceCutoff: Parfum/Fragrance is listed last (30) -> positions 1-29 mechanically prominent, including preservatives and fragrance allergens (an atypical ordering; recorded as uncertainty)

cleansingStrength.rationale: C5: defining anionic Sodium Lauryl Sulfate (2, alkyl sulfate) with at least two prominent buffers - Cocamidopropyl Betaine (3), Coco-Betaine (14), Coco-Glucoside (15) - and no reinforcing strong anionic -> moderate.
cleansingStrength.counterSignals: Two of the three buffers (14, 15) are prominent only because Parfum is listed last; on a conventional fragrance position SLS + one betaine would read strong under C5. Lauroyl/Myristoyl Methyl Glucamide (19) is a sugar-based nonionic (assigned nonionic by chemistry).

conditioningLevel.rationale: One cationic system, Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (17), plus light routes: weak refatters Glyceryl Oleate (9), Lecithin (12), Hydrogenated Palm Glycerides Citrate (16), pearlizer Glycol Distearate (10), humectants Honey (5), Glycerin (8). C2 not met (no silicone, no prominent payload lipid; weak refatters cannot substitute).
conditioningLevel.counterSignals: Guar sits late (17); all lipid-like routes are weak refatters; alkyl sulfate chassis.

weightPotential.rationale: Only weak refatters and one late cationic guar face a sulfate reset; no silicone, payload lipid or film former.

depositionLoad.rationale: Guar (17) plus weak refatters (9, 12, 16, 21) and Tocopherol (20).

persistence.rationale: No persistent silicone/lipid system; refatters are light.

resetCapacity.rationale: SLS with betaine/glucoside buffers (C5 moderate), close to strong.

weightPotential.whyThisBand: Deposition is light and low-persistence against an effective sulfate reset.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: W2: two families present, but the only cationic route is a single guar at 17 and the other family is weak_refatter only (plus humectants); no silicone, payload lipid or film former; reset is effective. Combined residue plausibly below noticeable.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Guar level unknown; honey/glycerin may add tacky feel; one step toward moderate is realistic.

focusPrimary.rationale: Formula-only candidate: moisture (humectant cluster Honey/Glycerin with guar and refatter support). No claims seen.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Positioning unknown. CSA formula half met via E4 humectant/refatting routes Glycerin (8) and Glyceryl Oleate (9) (prominent); no E4 comfort route.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole in the complete INCI.
